# A small library.<br>A shared place.
summary: A neighbourhood workshop explores a lending shelf for useful tools. Read the proposal, compare the choices and keep the working note. <br>An illustrative workshop brief. The options below are proposals to discuss, not measured results.



---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: purpose
## Borrow the tool.<br>Share the know-how.
summary: Start small enough to learn what the neighbourhood actually needs.

A lending shelf is more than a list of objects. People need to know what is available, how to use it and how to bring it back. The first trial can pair a short inventory with a regular moment to ask questions.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: choices
## Three ways to begin.
summary: Choose a manageable service before adding more objects.

- **A lending shelf:** a small inventory and a clear return routine.
- **A repair session:** use the tools together and exchange practical knowledge.
- **A travelling kit:** bring a prepared set to a neighbourhood event.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: comparison
## Compare the work, not just the objects.
summary: A wide table is part of the document. Scroll inside it to read all the columns.

| Option | What is shared | First audience | Place | Preparation | Return routine | Question to resolve |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lending shelf | Small hand tools | Neighbours | Workshop | Inventory and labels | Agreed return slot | Who checks the tools? |
| Repair session | Tools and know-how | Participants | Shared table | Facilitator and examples | End of session | Which tasks are suitable? |
| Travelling kit | A prepared selection | Event visitors | Community venue | Packing list and host | Check before leaving | How will it travel? |

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: trial
## One trial.<br>A useful conversation.
summary: Invite a small group to try a lending shelf and a short repair session together.

Write down the questions that arise: finding an item, understanding its use, arranging a return. Keep the first inventory modest. At the end, decide what to keep, change or stop before expanding the service.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: discussion
## Leave with a next step.
summary: A briefing starts the discussion. The working note keeps its context.

Which option is easiest to host? What needs a named volunteer? What should not be offered yet? Agree on one next step, then share a link to the relevant part of the note instead of copying disconnected fragments.
